definitions.gloss: promotion to the next grade; advancing a level
definitions.explanation: Moving up to the next grade in school, or advancing to a higher rank or level in a system such as martial arts or swimming classes.

examples.japanese: {無事|ぶじ}に{進級|しんきゅう}できた。
examples.english: I was able to advance to the next grade without any problems.

examples.japanese: {成績|せいせき}が{悪|わる}いと{進級|しんきゅう}できない{場合|ばあい}がある。
examples.english: If your grades are bad, you may not be able to advance to the next grade.

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}は{水泳|すいえい}の{進級|しんきゅう}テストに{合格|ごうかく}して、とても{喜|よろこ}んでいた。
examples.english: My son was very happy after passing the swimming level-up test.

notes:
USAGE:
{進級|しんきゅう} is commonly used for school grade advancement and for progressing through ranked levels in activities like martial arts, swimming, or other structured programs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {進級|しんきゅう}する (to advance to the next grade)
- {進級|しんきゅう}テスト (level-up test)
- {進級|しんきゅう}{試験|しけん} (promotion examination)

RELATED WORDS:
Compare with {進学|しんがく} (advancing to a higher school, such as from middle school to high school), which refers to moving between schools rather than between grades within the same school. Also compare with {留年|りゅうねん} (repeating a year/being held back), the opposite outcome.
